question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence given below.

Do not __linger__ in the corridor.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **hasten**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"linger"** means to stay in a place longer than necessary because of a reluctance to leave. (देर करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Don't linger at the park, we need to get home soon.
 
 
 
• **"Hasten"** means to be quick to do something or to move or act swiftly. (जल्दी करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Please hasten your steps; we are running late.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'linger'** is **'hasten'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **hasten**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trifle** (तुच्छ): Something of little value or importance.

 
 
• **Example:** He spent his time on trifles instead of focusing on his work.
 
 
 
• **Idle** (बेकार): Avoiding work; lazy or not active.
 
 
• **Example:** The machine sat idle for months before being repaired.
 
 
 
• **Delay** (विलंब): The act of postponing or slowing down.
 
 
• **Example:** The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
